heading: Printing and binding for the President
lead: The Director of the Government Publishing Office shall execute such printing and binding for the President as he may order and make requisition for.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section constitutes part of section 88 of act Jan. 12, 1895. Remainder of section is classified to section 1713 of this title.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 2014—Pub. L. 113–235 substituted “Director of the Government Publishing Office” for “Public Printer”.
